_note: The fixed local-test clip set (plan v1.3.10, S4L; OR-8). Image-to-video from supplied stills, one prompt per model (D-OR7-02: LTX's prompting guide differs from WAN's; never paste one model's prompt into the other). The still is staged by Jose on the service host under stillsRoot; before the first live run Jose replaces still.sha256 with the staged file's real SHA-256 (the engine refuses the all-zero placeholder with local_clip_still_unset). Offline tests use their own fixtures.

local-wan.prompt: A locksmith's service van parked on a sunny South Florida street, the camera slowly pushes in toward the van's side door, gentle handheld motion, realistic lighting, no text.
local-wan.negativePrompt: text, watermark, logo, distortion, blur, low quality

local-ltx.prompt: Slow cinematic push-in on a parked locksmith service van, bright daylight, palm trees in the background, subtle camera drift, photorealistic, clean frame without lettering.
local-ltx.negativePrompt: words, letters, watermark, warped body, flicker
